The two-day Holiday Expo, featuring tourism destinations from India and abroad, began at the Gadiraju Palace Convention Center in the city on Friday.
More than 75 exhibitors from over 10 States and five international destinations are taking part. Rajasthan Tourism and Delhi Tourism are the partner States. Andhra Pradesh Tourism is showcasing the State’s beaches, heritage sites, pilgrim centres and nature tourism.
The stalls cover hotels, resorts, airlines, cruises and travel technology. The expo is open to the travel trade and the public.
“Visakhapatnam is an important and growing travel market, and we are delighted to bring this platform to the city,” said Rohit Hangal, Director, Sphere Travelmedia and Exhibitions Pvt. Ltd.
Tours and Travels Association of Andhra Pradesh president K. Vijaymohan, Hotel and Restaurant Association of Andhra Pradesh president Pavan Kartheek and officials of the Rajasthan, Delhi and Andhra Pradesh tourism departments attended the inauguration.
The expo ends on Saturday. The next edition will be held in Coimbatore on January 29 and 30, 2027.
